metadata.title: Weak Acceleration? Rough Idle? Diagnose a Car or Truck Throttle Body! #shorts
metadata.channel: 1A Auto: Repair Tips & Secrets Only Mechanics Know
metadata.description:
Shop for New Auto Parts at 1AAuto.com https://1aau.to/c-229-ad

If your vehicle is experiencing weak acceleration, or rough idle, one of the areas you can diagnose is the throttle body. Over time, the valve of the throttle body collects debris and oil as the engine sucks air through it. This buildup can cause the throttle valve to drag or stick, resulting in poor throttle response, or incorrect air volumes! In this video, Len shows you how to diagnose and clean the throttle body to get your engine performing again. #shorts
